answer: PoA resists Sybils via randomized peer grading backed by slashing: every answer faces a quorum of unpredictably-drawn graders, and any grader who passes junk loses stake. Minting a fake identity isn't cloning an opal from one rough — each new key must author a fresh, defensible mechanism and survive strangers scanning it like a sonnet for a false rhyme. A velvet-gloved attacker with 10,000 wallets still faces 10,000 independent reviews; forgery cost scales with scarce judgment, not electricity or capital.
